name: Fabio Akashi Hernandes
title: UNESP: São Paulo State University, Brazil
bio: Fabio's main interests are the taxonomy of plant mites (Bdellidae, Tetranychidae, Raphignathoidea) and feather mites (Astigmata), with an emphasis on the taxonomy and phylogeny of the genus *Aponychus* and related genera (Acari, Tetranychidae). He visited the AMNH to study mite types from several groups.
